dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL style with ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, VALUE OF FILE-ID, and DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA; typical of Argentine university assignments compiled with GnuCOBOL
evidence: END PROGRAM TP2 / END PROGRAM SUBPGR nested structure

purpose.domain_detail: University algorithms course (Algoritmos 4) practical assignment TP2, likely Argentine university
purpose.summary: A main program (TP2) that opens indexed and sequential files for a vehicle rental system (alquileres), writes a report header, and calls a subprogram (SUBPGR) to look up client records by document number. SUBPGR manages a CLIENTES indexed file with open/search/close operations via an operation-code parameter.

notable_features: Two programs in one file: TP2 (main) and SUBPGR (called subprogram)
LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING in SUBPGR
Multiple indexed files with ALTERNATE KEYs
VALUE OF FILE-ID for file assignment
88-level condition names reused across multiple 77-level items (potential bug)
ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL for report output
verdict.notes: The program is clearly a student assignment ('TP 2 Algoritmos 4', author Leandro Denis). Three separate 77-level variables all define '88 EOF VALUE SI' which is a likely bug (condition name collision). No COMP-3 usage. The subprogram is nested within the same source file using END PROGRAM / PROGRAM-ID pattern.
